Quality 3–4 adds 1 to "Charge rolls made for this model". Knights (VEHICLE CHARACTER WALKER) can take Heroic Intervention ("End of your opponent’s Charge phase ... before making the charge roll"), and the app offers it to them. So the reminder also belongs in the opponent’s Charge phase; Move and Advance stay your turn.

fix.text: Quality 3–4 (eager for the challenge): +2" Move, +1 to Advance and Charge rolls.

why: The trigger is "Each time this model is selected to shoot or fight". Knights are TITANIC, so Fire Overwatch ("excluding TITANIC units") is out, and none can be selected to shoot in the opponent’s Shooting phase. Shooting is your turn only; fight stays either.

fix.text: Quality 1–2 (martial valour): each time a Knight shoots or fights, re-roll one Hit roll and one Wound roll.
